name: SERPAVI rent reference system
publisher: Ministerio de Vivienda y Agenda Urbana (Spain)

measures.definition: Median monthly rent per m² of flats let as a main home, from every lease declared in that year's income tax returns, times 50 m².
Median monthly rent per m² of flats let as a main home, from every lease declared in that year's income tax returns, times 90 m².

rights.edition: Base de datos SERPAVI 2011-2024 (edition of 9 March 2026), sheet Municipios
rights.attribution: Source: Ministerio de Vivienda y Agenda Urbana, Sistema Estatal de Referencia del Precio del Alquiler de Vivienda (SERPAVI), last updated 9 March 2026

vetted.notes: Official, from tax returns; the ministry's legal notice allows commercial and non-commercial reuse with the source and update date cited and the content not distorted (Real Decreto 1495/2011). Idealista and Fotocasa asking rents are proprietary and stay links.

caveats: Every declared lease, sitting tenants included, so below the asking rents a newcomer meets in Madrid and Barcelona.
Per m² times a fixed flat size, the same 50 m² and 90 m² as every per-m² source.
